notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Sporemound triggers for each land that enters the battlefield this way, creating that many 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat.
